name: override
note: Author unicode-bidi: bidi-override (corpus/unicode-bidi, unicode-bidi feature): on block-level boxes with an explicit dir and text-align, the override forces the inline content's direction to the element's direction, so text-align:start/end resolves per that direction and the line boxes sit at the inline-start edge (o-ltr start=left, o-rtl start=right, o-ltr-end end=right, o-rtl-end end=left); on an inline span the box keeps its logical position in the line while its content direction is overridden. The engine resolves direction at the box level so these line-box rects and fragments match Chrome exactly; the per-glyph mirroring of the override runs is a declared no-UBA divergence under the text tier (docs/ledgers/unicode-bidi.md).
